csv_project_name: Engineering Svc for S Bethlehem Greenway P VIII
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Bethlehem, Northampton County, Pennsylvania ( the City ), is seeking to retain services of a qualified and experienced consulting firm to design an urban trail and dynamic recreation space between S New Street and E Third Street. It will continue the South Bethlehem Greenway and complement the abutting commercial developments. The selected consultant will work with the City to refine the conceptual designs, coordinate design with the hotel project team, and provide professional design/engineering for preliminary and final design, construction documentation, bid documents, and construction-term services. The concept plan has outlined recommendations for the greenway, as summarized below: - General: Greenway path continuation from S New Street to E Third Street, seating, trash receptacles, lighting, signage - Gathering Spaces: Amphitheater (including seating and stage) - Nearby Nature: Native shade trees, native flowering trees, native shrub and perennials, native groundcover bed, sod lawn
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Engineering Services for South Bethlehem Greenway Phase VIII
short_description: Design services for an urban greenway extension with recreation spaces and landscape elements.
project_scope: Design of an urban trail and recreation space between South New Street and East Third Street in Bethlehem, continuing the South Bethlehem Greenway and coordinating with adjacent commercial development and a hotel project. The concept includes greenway path continuation, seating, trash receptacles, lighting, signage, an amphitheater with seating and stage, and landscape works with native shade trees, flowering trees, shrubs, perennials, groundcover beds, and lawn.
services: Consulting design and engineering services including refinement of conceptual designs, coordination with the hotel project team, preliminary and final design, construction documentation, bid documents, and construction-term services. Requested disciplines: landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an urban greenway, landscape, and public space project rather than a structural engineering project.
- Scope focuses on trail design, landscape architecture, amenities, and recreation space.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or complex building structure is described.
- Includes civil and geotechnical input, but these are secondary to landscape/open-space planning.
- Matches sbp rejection guidance for pure urban/open space planning.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The described scope includes trail continuation, site furnishings, lighting, landscaping, and a small amphitheater, but there is insufficient quantitative information for a reliable estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The procurement is for multidisciplinary consulting design and engineering services, but there is not enough information on budget, phases, or fee basis for a reliable estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced consulting firm required. Specific minimum references or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source excerpt.
